# Residency Advisor

> Residency Advisor is a comprehensive platform for medical students to search, compare, and match with residency and fellowship programs across all specialties using AI-powered matching and interview preparation tools.

The platform provides an all-in-one solution for the residency application journey, including program discovery, specialty exploration, open position tracking, and SmartPick AI matching. It serves medical students pursuing USMLE/COMLEX certification across competitive and primary care specialties.

## Key Topics

- Residency Programs
- Fellowship Opportunities
- Medical Specialties
- Program Search & Filters
- SmartPick AI Matching
- Interview Preparation
- USMLE/COMLEX
- ACGME Accreditation
- Open Positions
- Specialty Training
- Competitive Specialties
- IMG-Friendly Programs
- Medical Education
- Program Directory
- Residency Match

## Getting Started

- [Your Residency Journey Starts Here](https://residencyadvisor.com): All-in-one platform with SmartPick AI matching, interview prep, and specialty search.

## Program Search & Opportunities

- [Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty): Search and compare residency programs across all medical specialties.
- [Open Positions - Residency & Fellowship Opportunities](https://residencyadvisor.com/open-positions): Browse unfilled PGY slots and fellowship opportunities outside Match cycle.

## Clinical Specialties

- [Internal Medicine Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/internal_medicine): Explore Internal Medicine with fellowship opportunities in cardiology, GI, endocrinology.
- [Family Medicine Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/family_medicine): Explore Family Medicine primary care residency programs.
- [Emergency Medicine Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/emergency_medicine): Explore Emergency Medicine acute care residency programs.

## Surgical Specialties

- [Orthopaedic Surgery Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/orthopaedic_surgery): Explore competitive Orthopaedic Surgery residency programs.
- [Neurological Surgery Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/neurological_surgery): Explore competitive Neurological Surgery residency programs.
- [Otolaryngology Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/otolaryngology): Explore competitive ENT/Otolaryngology head and neck surgery programs.

## Procedural & Specialty Medicine

- [Anesthesiology Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/anesthesiology): Explore Anesthesiology programs with perioperative and pain management focus.
- [Dermatology Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/dermatology): Explore competitive Dermatology residency programs including Mohs surgery.
- [Ophthalmology Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/ophthalmology): Explore competitive Ophthalmology residency with LASIK surgical training.
- [OB/GYN Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/obstetrics_gynecology): Explore OB/GYN residency with maternal-fetal medicine and reproductive endocrinology.

## Diagnostic & Specialized Medicine

- [Neurology Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/neurology): Explore Neurology programs covering Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, and EEG/EMG.
- [Nuclear Medicine | Radioactive Tracers in Diagnosis and Treatment](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/nuclear_medicine): Explore Nuclear Medicine residency with PET scans and radionuclide therapy.
- [Allergy & Immunology | Comprehensive Care for Immune Disorders](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/allergy_immunology): Explore Allergy & Immunology residency and fellowship programs.
- [Medical Genetics Residency Programs](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/medical_genetics_genomics): Explore Medical Genetics & Genomics residency and fellowship programs.

## Optional

- [Combined Specialties | Interdisciplinary Training and Broadened Scope](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/combined_specialties): Explore interdisciplinary dual-specialty residency programs.
- [Osteopathic Neuromusculoskeletal Medicine | Holistic Musculoskeletal Care](https://residencyadvisor.com/specialty/osteopathic_neuromusculoskeletal_medicine): Explore Osteopathic Neuromusculoskeletal Medicine with OMT training.
